title: Andalusian Millet Bake
description: A flavorful and nutritious Indian-inspired millet bake, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish combines the nutty taste of millet with the juiciness of andalusian tomatoes.

ingredients.name: andalusian tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Juicy and sweet, perfect for this bake

instructions: Rinse the millet and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté the chopped onion until translucent.
Add grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the andalusian tomatoes, garam masala, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes.
Mix in the soaked millet and 2 cups of water.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with a sprinkle of bake.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the millet is cooked and the top is golden brown.
